title: Lab Result Upload Freshness
dataSources: Pump telemetry (`health:glucose`), lab results (`health:lab`), therapy sessions (`health:pt`), symptom diaries (`health:symptom`), care tasks (`health:ops`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management telemetry — insulin-pump events, A1c lab imports, physical-therapy rep logs, and symptom diaries — streamed to Splunk HEC via device exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=health:lab lab_source=* collected_epoch=* uploaded_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((uploaded_epoch-collected_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by lab_source
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures lab upload lag by lab source for lab-result imports.
value: Lag tracking shows which lab source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside lab-result imports.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `lab upload lag` on `health:lab` events and aggregate them by `lab_source`.
visualization: Table of lab source with average and worst lab upload lag.
grandmaExplanation: It records how long things take for each lab source so you can see where lab-result imports slows down.
